headline: Nanbeige releases a 33B open-weight model and reports a strong but uneven agent benchmark profile
summary: Nanbeige LLM Lab has published Nanbeige4.3-33B as a 33B BF16 model under Apache 2.0 and positions it as a teacher for a planned smaller model. Its model card reports results across coding, workplace-agent and reasoning benchmarks, using the same stated inference hyperparameters and harness per benchmark across listed models. The table is mixed: Nanbeige leads on many listed tasks but trails a comparator on SWE-Bench Pro and GDPval, and trails Gemma4 on GPQA Diamond. These are lab-reported results, not independent measurements.
